Class MinHeap<T extends Comparable<T>>

java.lang.Object
assignments.datastructures.MinHeap<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of values stored in the heap
All Implemented Interfaces:
adt.PriorityQueue<T>
public class MinHeap<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Object implements adt.PriorityQueue<T>
A priority queue that uses a min heap stored in a Vector. A min heap keeps the smallest value at the top. This means the smallest value is removed first. The heap is stored in a Vector. Each parent has a value that is smaller than or equal to its children. Enqueue takes O(log N) time because a new value may need to move up the heap. Dequeue takes O(log N) time because a value may need to move down the heap. Peek takes O(1) time because the smallest value is always at index 0.
